message: Azure specs should not be using decorator "$extension" from @typespec/openapi or @azure-tools/typespec-autorest. They will not apply to other emitter.
Per the Noun_Verb convention for Operation Ids, the noun 'WidgetParts' should not appear after the underscore.
This GET operation uses a collection route but does not emit `x-ms-pageable`. Use an ARM list operation template, or add `@list` and annotate the response with `@pageItems` and `@nextLink`.
